children: Expand Energy Corp. (EXE) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 16, 2026.

On September 16, 2026, Expand Energy Corporation (the "Company") announced that, effective as of the closing of the Company's previously announced acquisition of Twin Eagle Holdings N.A., LLC, Dan Turco will no longer serve as Executive Vice President—Marketing and Commercial. Mr. Turco will continue to serve the Company as Executive Vice President of Commercial Activities and will focus on LNG and assist on the gas marketing integration.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895126/000089512626000053/exe-20260916.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895126/000089512626000053/0000895126-26-000053-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
